decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p>APL.E.00 Existing Site and Block Plans; APL-DR-P1-00-01- Existing Ground Floor Plan; APL-DR-P1-00-02- Existing First Floor Plan; APL-DR-P1-RL-04 – Existing Roof Plan; APL-DR-P1-XX-50 Existing Front and Rear Elevations; PL-DR-P1-XX-51 - Existing LHS and RHS Elevations; APL-DR-P1-XX-60 – Existing 3D; APL-DR-P2-00-11 – Proposed Ground Floor Plan; PL-DR-P2-01-12 – Proposed First Floor Plan; APL-DR-P2-RL-14 – Proposed Roof Plan; APL-DR-P2-XX-70 Proposed Front and Rear Elevations; PL-DR-P2-XX-71 – Proposed LHS and RHS Elevations; APL-DR-P2-XX-80 – Proposed 3D; APL-DR-P2-XX-81 – Proposed Perspective View; Fire Safety – Reasonable Exemption Statement&nbsp;</p><p><br></p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the side elevation on boundary with 11a Parkside Way, of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</p>
description: Single storey rear extension (Demolition of rear conservatory and pergola)
